descriptionPlain:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 


Purpose of the role
 
We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Account Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you will own and develop key client relationships across a defined portfolio of top UK automotive retail accounts. You’ll sit at the heart of a cross-functional “pod” that includes sales, professional services, and customer success - acting as the strategic lead and advocate for your customers.
 
You will be responsible for ensuring the retention and growth of your accounts, building long-term partnerships, driving client satisfaction, and identifying opportunities for expansion within your portfolio.

lists.content:
• Own the Relationship: Serve as the primary point of contact for a defined portfolio of clients, building trusted advisor relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Drive Retention and Growth: Lead initiatives to retain clients and expand revenue opportunities with the sales executive on the accounts through upsell and cross-sell strategies.
  • Lead the Pod: Coordinate cross-functional teams (sales, professional services, customer success) to deliver cohesive account strategies and ensure aligned execution.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and maintain strategic account plans, identifying client goals, risks, opportunities, and business outcomes.
  • Customer Advocacy: Represent the voice of the customer internally, ensuring that product development, support, and service delivery align with client needs.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track account health and performance, using data and insights to proactively address challenges and improve both adoption and satisfaction.

• At least 4 years of hands-on experience managing client accounts, with a focus on customer success and business growth.
  • Proven experience in account management, preferably within the SaaS or software sector.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and customer lifecycle management, experience in automotive retail is a bonus!
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as solution selling or consultative selling.
  • Knowledge of customer success best practices and account retention strategies.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, with a consultative and customer-centric approach.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholder relationships across complex environments.
  • Comfortable with commercial discussions, contract negotiations, and revenue accountability.
  • Strategic thinker with a results-driven mindset and the ability to translate business needs into actionable solutions.
  • Willingness to travel as needed across the UK.

This is a high-impact, highly collaborative role sitting at the intersection of AI engineering and customer service excellence. As an Agentforce Solutions Developer within the Customer Enablement (CE) organisation, you will be central to realising Keyloop’s investment in AI-powered customer operations – building, optimising and scaling intelligent agents to drive meaningful efficiency across our global support and service operations.

You will work closely with CE leaders, functional heads, and cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver a cohesive programme of AI-powered developments that reduce effort, accelerate resolution, improve customer outcomes, and advance the sophistication and autonomy of our AI agents. This role is part of Keyloop’s growing Global Delivery Hub in Vietnam.

lists.content:
Agentforce Platform Development

  • Design, build and continuously improve AI agent flows within Salesforce Agentforce, progressing Kara’s capabilities across increasingly autonomous use cases
  • Develop and refine prompts, actions, flows, and integrations that enable Kara to handle increasingly complex support interactions autonomously
  • Maintain and extend the Agentforce knowledge base, working alongside the Knowledge & Education team to ensure high-quality, KCS-aligned content underpins AI responses
  • Integrate Agentforce with Keyloop's broader technology stack including Salesforce Service Cloud, internal DMS data, and the Fusion platform
  • Evaluate and integrate external LLM capabilities (e.g. Anthropic Claude API, Microsoft Copilot Studio) where they augment or extend Agentforce’s native functionality

    •  

     

    Service & Process Efficiency

    • Identify automation opportunities across CE processes – from first-contact resolution and case routing to proactive customer communication and self-service deflection
    • Partner with the Data Analytics team to analyse support data, case trends, and agent handling patterns to surface AI use cases that reduce manual effort and improve customer retention
    • Partner with the business to deploy solutions that directly reduce cost-to-serve while lifting customer satisfaction
    • Support the evolution of AI-assisted tooling for CE agents, including in-call guidance, auto-summarisation, and next-best-action recommendations

      •  

      Cross-Functional Collaboration

      • Engage CE leadership and heads of function (Support, Retention, Operations, Knowledge & Education) to align AI development priorities with strategic goals
      • Liaise with Keyloop's wider Product, Engineering, and AI CoE teams to ensure CE developments are coherent with platform-wide AI strategy
      • Communicate technical roadmaps, build progress and outcomes clearly to non-technical stakeholders, translating AI capability into business value

        •  

        Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement

        • Apply rigorous testing, monitoring and feedback loops to ensure AI agents perform accurately, safely, and consistently at scale
        • Document technical designs, integration specifications, and operational runbooks to support team scalability and knowledge transfer
        • Stay current with Salesforce Agentforce releases, Einstein AI updates, LLM provider developments (Claude, Copilot), and emerging AI/ML trends relevant to customer service
        • Champion responsible AI principles in all development work, ensuring outputs are explainable, auditable, and aligned with Keyloop's values

Essential

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce platform development – including Flows, Apex, and Lightning Web Components
  • Practical experience with Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein AI, or comparable conversational/generative AI development platforms
  • Strong understanding of API integration patterns and the ability to connect AI agents to third-party systems and data sources
  • Experience working with LLM APIs and orchestration (e.g. Anthropic Claude API, Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Copilot Studio) or a strong willingness to develop this expertise quickly
  • Understanding of prompt engineering principles, including techniques for grounding, guardrails, and output quality
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into working technical solutions
  • Experience working in customer service, support, or ITSM environments – understanding the workflow context your solutions will operate in
  • Clear and confident communicator in English, able to collaborate effectively across time zones and cultures

    •  

    Desirable

    • Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns or knowledge-grounded AI architectures
    • Familiarity with multi-agent or multi-model architectures – orchestrating workflows across different AI providers
    • Experience with JavaScript (relevant to Lightning Web Components and integration scripting)
    • Understanding of data privacy and AI governance considerations, particularly in multi-region operations
    • Interest in or exposure to automotive, DMS, or SaaS B2B software environments
    • Experience within a global delivery model, ideally collaborating with teams in the UK or Europe
      • Salesforce certifications (e.g. Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, Service Cloud Consultant)

In your first 90 days, you will have:

  • Developed a deep understanding of the CE function, its strategic goals, and the current Agentforce/Kara deployment
  • Identified and scoped your first high-value automation or AI improvement, with a clear delivery plan agreed with CE leadership
  • Established strong working relationships with your key stakeholders across CE and the wider Keyloop AI community

    •  

    Ongoing measures of success include:

    • Demonstrable progression of Kara’s agent capabilities across key CE use cases
    • Measurable reduction in manual handling time, case volumes, or cost-to-serve attributable to AI deployments
    • High adoption of AI tools by CE agents and positive feedback from both agents and customers
      • On-time, high-quality delivery of agreed development work with clear documentation

Titre du poste :
Analyste Support IT 

Description du poste
Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la gestion des services informatiques internes.
En tant que technicien support IT de niveau 2, vous serez le second point de contact pour les collaborateurs ayant besoin d’assistance technique. Vous serez responsable de diagnostiquer, résoudre et documenter les incidents et demandes de niveau 2, tout en assurant un support direct pour les postes de travail et les comptes utilisateurs. 

Responsabilités principales
Fournir un excellent service client en tout temps
Assurer un support technique de niveau 2 aux employés (PC, réseau, matériel) via téléphone, email, Microsoft Teams ou en présentiel 
Maintenir et administrer les plateformes utilisées par l’équipe IT
Fournir des conseils techniques et former les utilisateurs internes
Installer et configurer les postes de travail et équipements IT 
Gérer les demandes liées aux comptes utilisateurs
Collaborer avec les différentes équipes chez Keyloop
Respecter les SLA (accords de niveau de service)
Assurer le suivi et la résolution des incidents utilisateurs (à distance ou sur site) 
Suivre, documenter et gérer les tickets via l’outil ITSM
Maintenir la sécurité des utilisateurs et des systèmes
Proposer des améliorations aux processus IT

Connaissances et expérience
Forte capacité de résolution de problèmes multi-technologies
Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en administration Microsoft O365 et Azure
Bonne maîtrise des produits Microsoft O365
Bonne connaissance d’Active Directory (gestion des utilisateurs, groupes, sécurité)
Connaissance des réseaux d’entreprise (TCP/IP, protocoles réseau)
Expérience sur Windows et macOS
Capacité à générer des rapports O365 (analyse, audit, projets)
Excellentes compétences en documentation et rédaction technique
Bonne communication avec différents interlocuteurs
Expérience avec outils de ticketing et help desk
Capacité à gérer de petits projets et à encadrer des profils juniors
Connaissances AS400 et Lotus Notes (atout) 

Compétences et aptitudes
Résolution de problèmes
Dépannage O365, Windows, macOS, Azure et Active Directory
Gestion et contribution à la résolution d’incidents majeurs
Participation aux escalades si nécessaire 
Collaboration et relationnel
Agir comme point de contact de niveau 2 pour les employés
Développer une image positive du service IT
Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation
Esprit d’équipe et capacité à travailler de manière autonome 
Conditions spécifiques
Présence régulière au bureau (Montreal)
Astreinte occasionnelle (support hors horaires)
Déplacements ponctuels possibles
 
Job Title:
IT Support Analyst
Job Description
In this role, you will contribute to the management of internal IT services.
As a Level 2 IT Support Analyst, you will act as the second point of contact for employees requiring technical assistance. You will be responsible for diagnosing, resolving, and documenting Level 2 incidents and requests, while providing direct support for workstations and user accounts.

Key Responsibilities
Provide excellent customer service at all times
Deliver Level 2 technical support to employees (PC, network, hardware) via phone, email, Microsoft Teams, or onsite
Maintain and administer IT platforms used by the IT team
Provide technical guidance and training to internal users
Install and configure workstations and IT equipment
Manage user account-related requests
Collaborate with various teams across Keyloop
Ensure adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements)
Monitor and resolve user incidents (remotely or onsite)
Track, document, and manage tickets via the ITSM tool
Maintain user and system security
Recommend improvements to IT processes

Knowledge & Experience
Strong multi-technology problem-solving skills
Minimum 3 years of experience with Microsoft O365 and Azure administration
Good knowledge of Microsoft O365 products
Solid understanding of Active Directory (user management, groups, security)
Knowledge of corporate networks (TCP/IP, network protocols)
Experience with Windows and macOS
Ability to generate O365 reports (analysis, audits, projects)
Excellent documentation and technical writing skills
Strong communication skills across different stakeholders
Experience with help desk/ticketing tools
Ability to manage small projects and mentor junior team members
Experience with AS400 and Lotus Notes (nice to have)

Skills & Competencies
Problem Solving
Troubleshooting O365, Windows, macOS, Azure, and Active Directory
Contributing to the resolution of major incidents
Supporting escalations when required
Collaboration & Interpersonal Skills
Act as a Level 2 point of contact for employees
Promote a positive image of the IT service function
Demonstrate autonomy, organisation, and attention to detail
Strong team player with the ability to work independently

Summary:
 
The Business Systems Analyst – Data & Integrations plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. This role involves gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements, and working closely with stakeholders to ensure that the solutions meet the business objectives. Being in our data & integrations function, you will play a critical role in supporting and enabling our data warehousing, system integrations and reporting

lists.content:
Requirements Gathering 

  • Collaborate with global business stakeholders from across the organization (e.g. sales, marketing, customer enablement, finance) to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements for gathering and mapping data from disparate sources (e.g. different CRMs, ERPs or downstream applications) for system integrations and centralised reporting. Understanding the different insights needed for different business areas. 

Data Literacy 

  • Demonstrate deep technical fluency, data literacy, and sharp commercial awareness to map out how data flows, transforms, and is presented across enterprise systems. 

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to pull data together from multiple sources, to gain deeper insights, and guide them to “put data first” to improve our analytical capabilities. 

  • Educate stakeholders on the upstream and downstream impacts to integrations and reporting, e.g. field or data changes can break these if not flagged early. 

Collaboration: 

  • Collaborate with IT teams, software vendors, and business units to ensure that system integrations and reporting meet user needs. 

  • Act as a liaison between technical teams (e.g., developers, IT architects) and business users (across the business) to ensure that requirements are accurately understood and implemented. 

Challenge: 

  • Question the “as is” and explore options for the “to be”, recognising that what is being asked for is not always what is needed. 

  • Ensure that requirements are understood and implemented correctly. 

Documentation 

  • Create detailed documentation including functional specifications, epics, user stories, use cases, process maps, and data flow diagrams, tailored to financial systems and audiences. 

  • Develop and maintain user manuals, system documentation, and training materials for reporting systems. 

Testing and Validation 

  • Assist in the development of test cases and testing procedures for new or updated reports and their data. 

  • Coordinate business acceptance testing (BAT) and ensure that systems meet business, accounting, and audit requirements before go-live. 

Prioritisation: 

  • Help prioritise system requirements based on business needs, resource  availability, and the potential business impact. 

  • Work with BSAs from other other workstream as well as  stakeholders to balance competing requirements and determine the most important features or improvements for reporting systems. 

Communication and Change Management 

  • Provide clear, timely communication to business stakeholders regarding report changes, expected impacts, timelines, and training. 

  • Support change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business analysis or a related field. 
  • Experience of data ETL transformation, migration and warehousing 
  • Ideally show proficiency in querying databases and using visualization tools (like Snowflake or Power BI) to help to drive decisions. 
  • Familiarity with business analysis tools and techniques (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Miro). 
  • Knowledge of industry-standard methodologies and frameworks (e.g., BABOK, BPMN). 
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment is preferred. 
  • Data analytics certification is preferred
  • Strong analytical, mathematical and problem-solving skills. 
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.

lists.content:
As an Data Editorial Technician, you will work within the centralised group data team working on the distribution of predominantly vehicle datasets. By working in the central data service as a Data Editorial Technician, your role is predominantly oriented around ensuring high data quality, accuracy and timely availability. 

As part of your duties, you will be required to analyse the accuracy of the vehicle data within your remit and work to improve it; either by escalating inaccuracies to appropriate stakeholders or third parties, or by embellishing the data within group-approved tooling.

• Supporting the efficient and consistent importing and availability of vehicle datasets  

  • Completing data processes that other teams are dependent on in a timely manner, focusing on clear communication with interested stakeholders and striving for high-quality and completeness in the data  

  • Continually improving team processes and working practices in pursuit of higher quality data  

  • Researching third-party or creating first-party datasets to supplement or augment existing datasets (e.g., to address gaps in data by either sourcing another provider to plug those gaps, or creating and maintaining a new dataset to do so)  

  • Generating reports or documentation for customers, third parties or internal stakeholders as required  

  • Documenting processes (or SOPs) for commonly performed tasks to assist with the training of other Data Editorial Technicians or to support the training/handover of any applicable tasks to Technical Support, or to aid business continuity as a general theme.  

  • Working with Product Owners/Managers and the Software Engineering community to identify/rationalise product improvements where relevant  

  • Supporting colleagues on calls or in meetings with clients, partners and suppliers as required  

  • You will work in support of the group Data Engineering function to identify areas for improvement and work with engineers to implement workable, scalable, and automated solutions to currently manual tasks. You should work in alignment with the Keyloop data culture of adopting an automation-first mindset.

lists.content:
As a Digital Customer Engagement Specialist you help our global customers get the most from Keyloop by making sure they know about the training and learning available to them. Working alongside the Knowledge and Education team, you will spot opportunities where a well-timed message could help customers, draft clear and engaging copy, and partner with Marketing to get that content prepared, translated and delivered through the right channels (email, in-application and social such as LinkedIn). 

 

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role. It suits someone early in their career who enjoys writing, is organised, works well as part of a team, and is comfortable collaborating with colleagues across different departments and cultures.

• Identify opportunities where communications could help customers understand and make use of Keyloop training and learning. 

  • Draft clear, engaging copy for training-related communications, tailored to the audience and channel. 

  • Work with Marketing to ensure communications are prepared, translated and delivered from the right channels, including email, in-application messaging and social channels such as LinkedIn. 

  • Maintain a schedule of outbound training communications, keeping content organised, on-brand and on time. 

  • Gather feedback and basic engagement data to understand what is working and suggest improvements. 

  • Build good working relationships with colleagues across Knowledge & Education, Marketing and other departments. 

  • Any other duties commensurate with the grade and level of responsibility of the role.

• Strong written communication skills, with an eye for clear, engaging and audience-appropriate copy. 

  • A genuine interest in customer experience and in helping customers succeed. 

  • Well organised, with the ability to manage a schedule of content and meet deadlines. 

  • Comfortable working as part of a team and collaborating across different departments and cultures. 

  • Confident using digital tools to create and edit communication content. 

  • Willing to learn, take feedback, and develop under the guidance of a more experienced colleague. 

  • Basic comfort with data, able to look at simple engagement measures and act on them.

Essential 

  • Educational qualifications   

  • Good standard of general education, including GCSE Maths and English (Grade C / 4 or above) or equivalent. 

  • A qualification, apprenticeship or early experience in communications, marketing, English or a related area is an advantage but not essential. 

 

Desirable 

  • Technical / Professional qualifications in  

  • Any communications, marketing or customer experience training, certificate or diploma.

The Engineering Lead is the first formal step into engineering leadership at Keyloop, bridging the role of a senior individual contributor and the people-focused Engineering Manager. This role is accountable for the technical success of a specific, complex project, establishing the technical vision, breaking complex problems into actionable plans, and guiding a team of engineers through execution. The Engineering Lead is the first formal step into engineering leadership at Keyloop, bridging the role of a senior individual contributor and the people-focused Engineering Manager. This role is accountable for the technical success of a specific, complex project, establishing the technical vision, breaking complex problems into actionable plans, and guiding a team of engineers through execution. The Engineering Lead remains hands-on, contributing code to the most critical or complex parts of the project, while their primary focus shifts from personal output to the collective technical success of the team they lead, all aligned with Keyloop’s “Experience-First” philosophy.

lists.content:
Technical Leadership & Innovation 

  • Establish the technical vision and architectural direction for a project 

  • Lead design and code reviews, setting a high bar for quality and consistency 

  • Remain hands-on, writing code for the most critical or complex parts of the project 

  • Make sound technical decisions and clearly articulate the trade-offs involved 

  • Champion the adoption of AI-empowered development tools and ensure the project team leverages them effectively 

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their fit for the project 

Execution & Delivery 

  • Own the technical delivery of the project end to end, accountable for the outcome 

  • Break down complex problems into clear, actionable plans the team can execute 

  • Manage the project’s technical roadmap and track progress against the plan 

  • Proactively identify, surface, and resolve project risks and blockers 

  • Ensure the project consistently meets its commitments on quality and timeline 

  • Optimize the team’s workflow through strategic use of AI and automation tools 

People Leadership 

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance, accelerating the growth of engineers on the project 

  • Pair with engineers to solve difficult problems and elevate their capabilities 

  • Build consensus around technical decisions through facilitation, not authority 

  • Set an example of engineering craft that raises the standard for the whole team 

  • Foster a culture of psychological safety, technical rigor, and continuous improvement 

  • Guide engineers in developing AI literacy and effective use of AI tools 

Communication & Collaboration 

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for the project, interfacing with the Engineering Manager and Product 

  • Articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 

  • Communicate project status, risks, and trade-offs openly to leadership and stakeholders 

  • Facilitate productive design discussions that lead to clear decisions and actions 

  • Write clear, concise technical design documents that anchor the project 

Product & Business Impact 

  • Collaborate with Product to translate requirements into a coherent technical vision 

  • Ensure the team understands the “why” behind their work and its business value 

  • Propose alternative technical solutions that better meet customer needs or improve user experience 

  • Balance feature delivery, technical debt reduction, and innovation within the project 

  • Identify opportunities where AI can accelerate delivery or improve product quality 

What We're Looking For 

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience with a strong technical foundation 

  • Proven track record of leading complex, multi-sprint technical projects to successful delivery, typically as a Senior Engineer or Tech Lead 

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and accelerate their technical growth 

  • Experience designing and implementing robust, scalable solutions for team-sized projects 

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business contexts 

  • Experience with Agile methodologies (SAFe or Scrum) and modern software delivery practices 

  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted development tools and their impact on engineering productivity 

  • Ability to make sound technical decisions in the face of ambiguity, with incomplete information 

  • Aspiration to grow into Engineering Manager on the leadership track, or Staff Engineer on the technical track

• Technical Delivery: Your project consistently delivers on commitments with high quality 

  • Team Growth: Engineers on your project visibly grow their technical skills under your guidance 

  • Technical Excellence: The systems your project owns are well-designed, well-tested, and operationally healthy 

  • Innovation: Your project effectively leverages AI and modern tools to enhance productivity 

  • Stakeholder Trust: Product partners, the Engineering Manager, and leadership trust your project’s technical execution 

  • Decision Quality: Technical decisions are sound, well-reasoned, and clearly communicated 

  • Influence: You build consensus across the project team without relying on positional authority

This Engineering Lead position offers the unique opportunity to: 

  • Take the first formal step into engineering leadership while continuing to build world-class software 

  • Shape the technical direction of a critical project on the Fusion Automotive Retail Platform 

  • Pioneer the integration of AI into everyday engineering practices at the project level 

  • Develop your leadership craft with clear, defined pathways to Engineering Manager or Staff Engineer 

  • Be the technical anchor for a team while staying close to the codebase and the craft 

  • Have direct, measurable impact on both project outcomes and team capability

• Reporting into the Head of Customer Success within the Customer Enablement team
  • You will be assigned to customers where significant dissatisfaction has been reported, with the specific aim of returning the customer to a positive state within an agreed timeframe
  • You will monitor and escalate risk appropriately
  • You will work alongside Sales and Customer Success to ensure we have the best possibility of either new business or renewal
  • You will coordinate timely customer feedback and be essential in suggesting process improvements to prevent future escalations

• A skilled negotiator showing resilience during high-tension customer exchanges
  • Significant exposure to the software industry
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Capacity to use initiative and work alone or as part of a team as required
  • Experience of the automotive market
  • Excellent listening skills and balance empathy with the customer versus business demands
  • Work well under pressure and in times of crisis
  • Have a sense of humour, resilience and fun
  • English language is essential, fluency in French, Portuguese, German or Dutch would be advantageous.

Our Support Analyst will also assist colleagues, and will not only have outstanding verbal and written communication skills but can demonstrate that they are able to communicate quickly and efficiently at all levels across a Global team (Customer, peers, and Managers) in order to achieve our departmental and company strategy.
 
This role requires someone who is resourceful and well organized, with excellent analytical and problem solving skills, who is able to work effectively as part of a high performing team with a passion and commitment to providing service excellence.

• Ability to efficiently plan and prioritize workload to meet deadlines.

  • Investigation, analytical, problem solving and trouble shooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, including telephone, virtual methods, written, and verbal skills in local language and English.
  • Able to articulate simply complex problems or issues.

Role Overview

This role will require you to work on both internal and customer-facing systems, including our AI-enabled support portal that serves customers across the globe. You will design, build, and maintain full stack JavaScript applications — from responsive React front ends to Node.js APIs — while contributing to the CI/CD pipelines and AWS infrastructure that support them. You will work closely with product, design, and QA to deliver reliable, well-tested features. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable web applications using React and TypeScript 

  • Develop and maintain Node.js backend services and RESTful APIs 

  • Design and optimise database schemas and queries (SQL and/or NoSQL) 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, build, and deployment 

  • Deploy, configure, and manage application infrastructure on AWS 

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code following engineering best practices 

  • Collaborate with product, design, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features 

  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical planning 

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the stack, including in production 

  • Produce clear technical documentation for APIs, services, and deployment processes 

  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to team knowledge-sharing 

Required Skills & Experience 

  • 5+ years of professional full stack JavaScript development experience 

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript 

  • Hands-on experience with React, including hooks, context, and component architecture 

  • Solid Node.js backend development experience 

  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs 

  • Practical experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) 

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) 

  • Working knowledge of AWS services (e.g. EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) 

  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows 

  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: testing, debugging, and performance optimisation 

Desirable Skills 

  • Experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) 

  • Familiarity with GraphQL 

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) 

  • Exposure to microservices architecture 

  • Agile / Scrum experience 

  • AWS certification (e.g. Solutions Architect, Developer Associate)

Role Purpose
The Head of Legal is a management and delivery role responsible for the day-to-day running of the legal function. The role sits between the General Counsel and the wider legal team, providing the operational management layer that allows the function to deliver consistently, responsively and to a measurable standard. It is distinct from the General Counsel role, which retains strategic legal oversight, board-level risk management and executive advisory responsibilities.
The successful candidate will bring order, discipline and a clear service model to a function that currently lacks a dedicated management layer, and will act as the first point of escalation for the team and the business.

The role sits between the General Counsel and the wider legal team, providing the operational management layer that allows the function to deliver consistently, responsively and to a measurable standard. It is distinct from the General Counsel role, which retains strategic legal oversight, board-level risk management and executive advisory responsibilities.

lists.content:
TEAM MANAGEMENT AND DELIVERY:

  • Lead the day-to-day management of the legal team, including workload allocation, matter triage, prioritisation and tracking
  • Own the UK, Prague and India operating model, including handoff discipline, escalation rules and cross-border coordination
  • Provide people management for the team, including regular one-to-ones, coaching, performance monitoring and developmentand
  • Act as the first escalation point for the team, resolving matters at the appropriate level and escalating only genuinely strategic matters to the General Counsel

    •  

    STAKEHOLDER SERVICE:  
    • Own stakeholder service delivery, including response standards, communication discipline and adherence to agreed service levels
    • Maintain clear ownership of matters so that business stakeholders always know who is responsible for their request
    • Build and sustain effective working relationships with business unit leads across Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Finance and HR

      •  

      EXTERNAL COUNSEL AND COST CONTROL :
      • Manage and oversee external counsel spend, including instruction, oversight and cost management; and
        • Operate a clear mandate and approval framework for matters referred externally, reducing unmanaged outsourcing
          •  
          OPERATING DISCIPLINE AND IMPROVEMENT
          • Own the matter tracker and feed the function's KPI dashboard, managing the team to agreed standards of responsiveness, quality and backlog health
          • Implement and maintain intake standards, service tiers and triage rules
          • Drive process improvements, template standardisation and legal operations discipline
          • Execute legal risk controls, identify emerging risks and escalate them appropriately

            •

• A practical, commercially minded operator who can bring structure and discipline to a busy function
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills, with the ability to develop and motivate a dispersed team
  • Excellent prioritisation, organisation and stakeholder-management skills;
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, private equity-backed environment undergoing change
  • A delivery focus, with the judgement to know what to handle, what to delegate and what to escalate

• A functioning intake and triage model, with every matter carrying a named              owner and deadline
  • Consistent adherence to agreed service standards and a measurable                    reduction in escalations reaching the General Counsel
  • A clearer, more accountable UK, Prague and India operating model with               disciplined handoffs
  • Controlled and well-governed external counsel spend; and
  • A legal team that is better managed, better supported and more trusted by            the  business

• A qualified lawyer (England and Wales, or an equivalent jurisdiction) with substantial post-qualification experience, including in-house experience;
  • A strong commercial and technology background, ideally gained in a software, SaaS or technology business;
  • Proven experience managing a legal team, ideally across more than one location or jurisdiction; and
  • Demonstrable experience of managing external counsel and controlling legal spend.

lists.content:
The head of Projects is a senior PS leader responsible for the quality, consistency, and commercial performance of project delivery across Keyloop's global Professional Services organisation. This role owns the PM capability, the delivery governance framework, and the portfolio health infrastructure that gives Keyloop and its customers confidence that every project will be delivered to time, scope, and outcome.

This is both a leadership and an operational excellence role. The Head of Projects sets the standard for how Keyloop manages projects — from methodology and tooling through to PM capability and career development — and is accountable for driving that standard consistently across all regions and domains. They work in close partnership with Regional Delivery Managers, Domain Leads, and PS Ops to ensure the project engine runs with discipline, data, and pace

1. Portfolio Health & Governance

• Own the health of Keyloop's global PS project portfolio — maintaining real-time visibility of status, risk, and commercial performance across all active engagements.

• Implement and operate a Project Health model with RAG status tracking, early warning indicators, and tiered intervention protocols: direct PMO intervention for critical projects, regional-led recovery with PMO oversight for at-risk projects, and enhanced monitoring for projects showing early warning signs.

• Own the stage-gate intervention process — with authority to intervene when quality or commercial criteria are not met at key project milestones.

• Lead root cause analysis on project failures and overruns; translate findings into systemic improvements to methodology, tooling, and PM behaviour.

• Manage the escalation and exception process for scope disputes, commercial issues, and delivery roadblocks — with a 24-hour triage commitment for issues requiring senior intervention.

 

2. Delivery Methodology & Standards — SureStart

• Own and continuously evolve Keyloop's PS project delivery methodology, anchored in Keyloop SureStart — the productised project management framework that defines service levels, PM engagement models, and delivery standards across all implementation types.

• Ensure SureStart tiers (Project Coordination, Project Assisted, Project Managed, and Programme Managed) are clearly defined, consistently applied, and matched to the right engagement type and customer complexity at point of sale.

• Work with the Services Products team to keep SureStart commercially current: pricing, scope definitions, and SOW language aligned to what PS can deliver profitably and repeatably.

• Define and maintain the standard project artefact library: SOW templates, project plans, RAID logs, change request processes, cutover plans, and go-live readiness checklists — version-controlled and mandated for use across all regions.

• Build and enforce quality gate standards at key project milestones: requirements sign-off, UAT completion, go-live readiness, and post-go-live outcome validation.

• Lead methodology adoption across all PS teams — ensuring Keyloop Traction and SureStart delivery standards are embedded in every project regardless of region or domain.

 

3. Portfolio Analytics & Executive Reporting

• Deliver real-time portfolio dashboards providing visibility of project health, revenue at risk, utilisation, margin performance, and time to value across all regions.

• Produce weekly executive briefings covering critical interventions, resource constraints, forecast risk, and commercial impact.

• Develop predictive models linking project attributes — size, complexity, domain, PM experience — to delivery outcomes; use these to enable data-driven risk mitigation at project inception.

• Publish quarterly portfolio insight reports: pattern analysis, systemic improvement recommendations, and trend data to inform PS strategy.

• Automate reporting infrastructure to eliminate manual status compilation — giving PMs and regional leaders real-time self-service access to the data they need.

 

4. PM Capability & Community

• Define and own the PM competency framework for Keyloop PS — covering role profiles, skill requirements, and progression pathways from Associate PM through to Senior Programme Manager.

• Lead PM performance calibration in partnership with Regional Delivery Managers — identifying high-potential talent, capability gaps, and development priorities across the global PM community.

• Design and deliver a PM training and certification programme covering commercial acumen, stakeholder management, methodology mastery, and tooling proficiency.

• Build and run a PM community of practice: cross-regional peer learning, best practice sharing, lessons learned, and methodology evolution.

• Standardise PM onboarding to achieve productivity benchmarks within 60 days; build a searchable knowledge base of project case studies, delivery guides, and solution accelerators.

• Partner with the PS Academy to define a structured development framework that supports hiring for potential and building PM capability from within.

 

5. Commercial Performance

• Take accountability for the commercial performance of the PM function: PM team revenue, delivery margin, and utilisation performance against plan.

• Ensure projects are delivered within sold scope and margin — driving change control discipline and overrun management across all PMs and regions.

• Monitor and manage backlog health — volume, value, age, and scheduling — ensuring PS capacity is deployed against the right priorities at the right time.

• Track and improve time to start and time to value metrics across the project portfolio; identify and remove the systemic blockers that slow mobilisation and delivery.

• Provide accurate revenue and margin forecasting for the PM function; flag risks and opportunities with enough lead time to act.

 

6. Workforce Strategy & Global Delivery Centres

• Lead the PM workforce strategy in partnership with PS Ops and HR — aligning PM headcount, skills mix, and geographic distribution to current and future delivery demand.

• Drive the migration of appropriate PM activity into Regional Delivery Centres (RDCs) and Global Delivery Centres (GDCs), building centre-based PM capability as a scalable, cost-effective component of the global delivery model.

• Develop talent pipelines within GDCs: structured onboarding, progression pathways, and integration into Keyloop delivery culture and standards.

• Engage co-delivery partners where appropriate to provide elastic PM capacity, maintaining Keyloop quality standards across partner-led project management.

 

7. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Lead the automation of PMO and PM overhead — targeting elimination of manual reporting, status compilation, and administrative tasks through tooling, AI, and workflow automation, freeing PMs to focus on customers and delivery outcomes.

• Drive the adoption of AI to augment the PM role: AI-assisted project risk scoring, automated RAG status updates, intelligent scheduling, effort estimation validation, and early warning triggers — making PMs more effective, not replacing the judgement that matters.

• Use AI and automation to accelerate time to value for customers: reduce mobilisation time, automate routine project communications, digitise handover and go-live processes, and cut the administrative burden that slows projects down.

• Deploy AI-assisted tools for resource matching and capacity forecasting; measure and report the impact on forecast accuracy, utilisation, and delivery outcomes.

• Define and track an AI adoption metric for the PM function — what proportion of PM overhead has been automated, and what is the measurable impact on TTV and customer satisfaction.

• Champion a continuous improvement culture: structured retrospectives, systematic lessons learned, and rapid iteration on what isn't working.

Essential

• Senior leadership experience in project management and PMO within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

• Proven ability to build and operate governance frameworks at scale: methodology, tooling, quality gates, and portfolio health management.

• Familiarity with productised PS frameworks and tiered PM service models (e.g. Keyloop SureStart or equivalent) — able to own the methodology commercially as well as operationally.

• Experience driving AI adoption and automation within a PM or PMO function to augment team effectiveness and improve TTV.

• Commercial acumen: understands how PM decisions drive margin, utilisation, revenue recognition, and customer lifetime value.

• Strong data and analytics capability: designs reporting infrastructure, builds predictive models, and leads with quantified insight.

• Demonstrated success building PM capability — competency frameworks, training programmes, career pathways, and community of practice.

• Executive presence: able to present portfolio risk and recommendations to C-suite with clarity and confidence.

 

Desirable

• Knowledge of the automotive dealer or vehicle retail industry.

• Experience building PM capability within GDC or offshore delivery environments.

• Hands-on experience with AI/ML tools applied to project risk scoring, effort estimation, or delivery automation.

Education - Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or equivalent. Relevant postgraduate qualification desirable. 
 
Certifications - PRINCE2 Practitioner or PMP/PMI required. MSP, SAFe, or equivalent desirable. 
 
Experience - 10+ years in project management and PMO leadership roles within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
 

What 'Great' Looks Like in This Role

• Runs the PM function with the same commercial rigour as a P&L — knows the numbers, owns the outcomes.

• The portfolio has no surprises: risks are visible early, interventions happen before projects fail, and customers never experience a problem that Keyloop didn't see coming.

• PMs across all regions operate to a consistent standard — because the methodology, tooling, and training make that the path of least resistance.

• Reporting is automated, trusted, and used — not compiled manually and questioned.

• The PM community is genuinely engaged: learning, sharing, and raising the bar together.

• Every project closes with a customer who is live, adopting, and successful on the Keyloop Fusion platform.

lists.content:
In conjunction with the knowledge and education organisation, be actively involved in and take responsibility for the deployment and ongoing improvements to our knowledge management programs. Working with all functional areas in Keyloop to coach, audit and improve our knowledge bases whilst improving the self-serve culture and delivering against the strategy.  

 

The role will involve the need for a flexible approach, independent and TEAM working, collaboration with key stakeholders from many other departments and a strong ability to communicate across a range of cultures.

• Act as a master coach and knowledge expert to ensure we maintain a quality and relevant Knowledge Base for internal and customer usage. 

  • Actively participate in AI centric initiatives to drive knowledge programs throughout Keyloop. 

  • Deliver against the strategic framework outcomes for KCS outlined by senior leadership. 

  • Ensure KCS process is frequently audited for quality and deliver master coaching from with the Knowledge management team when necessary.  

  • Audit of Content Health, ensuring improvements get raised as part of the KCS evolve loop. 

  • Maintenance of knowledge management platforms and continuous improvement of KM workflows. 

  • Accountable for content standards and flow for what information is captured, where, by whom, and how it integrates with the rest of the tech stack, and how to keep it from growing stale. 

  • Encourage correct and widespread usage of the company's knowledge base through-out Keyloop. 

  • Drive  marketing activities to drive customers to self-serve via the customer hub. 

  • Any other duties commensurate with the grade and level of responsibility of the role.

• Deep technical knowledge, passion and experience in knowledge centred services. (KCS). 

  • An expert who is fully abreast of new thinking in the profession with strong networks . 

  • Strong understanding of AI-driven knowledge tools, with a proactive approach to applying them to advance KM strategy. 

  • Change Management. 

  • Data Analysis. 

  • Innovative and creative when approaching new challenges . 

  • Experience of coaching others. 

  • Positive, can-do attitude with the ability to adapt and work effectively in a changing environment . 

  • Excellent and proven cross-functional communication. 

  • Excellent organisational skills and able to work with deadlines. 

  • Strong analytical skills to effectively identify issues and be able to apply sound conclusions resulting in the right solution, at the right time and at the right cost. 

  • Goal orientated – maintains focus on agreed objectives and deliverables.  

  • Commercially orientated – keeps commercial aspects continually in mind when taking actions or making decisions.  

  • Proven ability to self-motivate and work independently as well as a track record of working professionally and collaboratively as part of a wider team. 

  • Ability to build and maintain good relationships. 

  • Communicate confidently and effectively, at management level, both in written and verbal form. 

  • Highly energised and motivated to effect change and influence the team's approach.

• Educational qualifications   

  • GCSE or equivalent 5 at Grade C or above including Math’s and English. 

  • Educated to college level as a minimum. Including 2 A levels or equivalent.

• Technical / Professional qualifications in  

  • Knowledge-Centred service (KCS) Practice certification 

  • Knowledge-Centred service (KCS) coaching

Ensure the Keyloop Procurement team is supported within agreed financial FY plans
              Finance:
Responsible for managing all intra-group services agreements at the direction of the Tax Director
Responsible for managing Keyloop’s registered trademark portfolio
Responsible for litigation accrual engagement with Finance and maintaining the L&C team process for recording and tracking litigation for these purposes
Support Treasury with any facility and working capital arrangements.
Cosec – responsible for all Keyloop group company administration requirements including the management of our company secretarial service provider
Co-ordinate the provision of legal support from external counsel for HR and Facilities
Support Finance with debt collection and customer claims including early termination settlements
Responsible for legal resource planning for the Procurement & Finance teams including management of external spend in line with L&C FY plans

Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 

Key Responsibilities

Procurement :

  • Responsible for optimizing and maintaining the Keyloop Legal & Compliance (L&C) process for supporting Procurement activity, including ownership of standard Keyloop purchasing template agreements, the publication of internal guidance, the provision of training and the maintenance of the procurement legal playbook for direct and indirect sourcing
  • Ensure the Keyloop Procurement team is supported within agreed financial FY plans

              Finance:

  • Responsible for managing all intra-group services agreements at the direction of the Tax Director
  • Responsible for managing Keyloop’s registered trademark portfolio
  • Responsible for litigation accrual engagement with Finance and maintaining the L&C team process for recording and tracking litigation for these purposes
  • Support Treasury with any facility and working capital arrangements.
  • Cosec – responsible for all Keyloop group company administration requirements including the management of our company secretarial service provider
  • Co-ordinate the provision of legal support from external counsel for HR and Facilities
  • Support Finance with debt collection and customer claims including early termination settlements
  • Responsible for legal resource planning for the Procurement & Finance teams including management of external spend in line with L&C FY plans

lists.content:
• Qualified solicitor, preferably UK qualified.
  • Excellent drafting skills.
  • Sound knowledge of the key principles and risks associated with the provision of technology solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate legal principles into simple, practical guidance.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating supplier agreements and ability to outline the key risk areas associated with the same.
  • Experience assessing litigation accruals and the key considerations when doing so.
  • Experience of supporting the Finance and Procurement function of a global business preferable.
  • Experience working within a global in-house legal team preferable.

additionalPlain:
Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
 
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity.  We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
 
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
 
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
 
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.  We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
 
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

lists.content:
Provision of an excellent support service is critical to the achievement of Keyloop's strategic plans for growth and profitability. The Managed Helpdesk Product Support Analyst will primarily be responsible for owning, troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving problems to successful closure, while ensuring timely escalation where necessary. 

The Managed Helpdesk Support Analyst specialising in Aftersales will assist colleagues and demonstrate outstanding verbal and written communication skills, communicating quickly and efficiently at all levels across a global team, including customers, peers and managers, to achieve departmental and company strategy. 

This role requires someone resourceful and well organised, with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, who can work effectively as part of a high-performing team with a passion and commitment to providing service excellence.

• Own and progress cases through to resolution by utilising available resources and expanding own knowledge. 

  • Escalate cases in good time. 

  • Respond with empathy to customers, dealing with their needs and acknowledging their operational pressures and deadlines. 

  • Communicate cooperatively with team members, other departments and management to deliver timely resolution of customer issues. 

  • Document solutions and produce written guidance on resolution steps and procedures. 

  • Be passionate and proactive in acquiring and absorbing knowledge of the Keyloop product suite and associated toolset, working closely with management to increase personal skills and competence. 

  • Use self-motivation and initiative to aid the investigation process and career development. 

  • Effectively coach and mentor colleagues to expedite case resolution and enhance knowledge within support. 

  • Ensure root cause analysis is carried out where necessary. 

  • Identify training gaps in knowledge media and recommend areas for improvement. 

  • Actively contribute to case reduction initiatives.

• Ability to efficiently plan and prioritise workload to meet deadlines. 

  • Investigation, analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. 

  • Excellent communication skills. 

  • Ability to articulate complex problems or issues in a simple manner. 

  • Knowledge and understanding of customer expectations. 

  • Ability to influence and overcome objections. 

  • Ability to interact with multiple levels of Keyloop customers and associates.

• Candidates must be fluent in Dutch and or French. 

  • Experience of supporting customers to a high level of performance, productivity and customer satisfaction. 

  • Understanding of the automotive industry and specialism in one business area. 

  • Experience of working with or supporting Keyloop Autoline / Autoline Drive product. 

  • Experience of working in the IT / software industry. 

  • Aftersales experience. 

  • Knowledge of the Autoline Accounting Module and Belgium Accounting Process’s would be advantageous. 

  • Customer service experience.

lists.content:
• Develop and execute account strategies to maximise client satisfaction and retention.
  • Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and new prospects in Germany and across DACH.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key automotive clients, major dealer groups and Account relationships ensuring seamless communication and service delivery.
  • Build strong relationships with key decision makers and confidently drive and communicate how Keyloop drives measurable business impact – aligning global Account strategy with localized priorities.
  • Analyse market trends and client feedback to inform product development and innovation.
  • Manage contract negotiations, renewals, and upselling of additional services.
  • Collaborate closely with sales, product, and technical teams to ensure client needs are met and exceeded.
  • Manage every stage of the sales funnel- prospecting, qualifying and closing solutions that meet customer needs.
  • Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned with customer priorities and Keyloop goals.
  • Deep understanding of customer operations, dealership operational workflows, dynamics and growth plans.
  • Prepare regular reports on account performance and progress toward targets.
    • Demonstrate strategic thinking ability to increase productivity YoY facilitating double digit business growth & % share of wallet.

• Fluent in German and Dutch
  • Minimum 8 years’ B2B sales experience in automotive industry 
  • Experience of using AI in Sales to enhance your sales functionality & capability
    • A proven track record of existing business sales gained in a technology solution sales environment where the ROI has been based on business process change/optimisation.
    • Able to demonstrate a professional structured sales approach incorporating Prospecting, Contact Management, Qualification, Presentation, Objection Handling and Closing Techniques.
    • Able to analyse a market objectively and identify relevant target prospects.
    • An ability to develop existing accounts together with identifying and securing new business opportunities.
      • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building abilities.
      • Ability to analyse client data and market trends to drive business growth.
        • Well-developed commercial and financial acumen.
          • Strong negotiation skills.
          • Highly Computer literate and familiarity with CRM/SFA systems.

Purpose of the role

The New Business Account Executive is responsible for generating, developing, and closing new logo SaaS opportunities across Alberta. This quota-carrying role focuses on building pipeline, winning new ARR, and positioning solutions that help automotive retailers improve performance, productivity, and customer experience.

lists.content:
• Own and deliver new business ARR targets within the assigned territory.
  • Prospect, qualify, and develop net-new opportunities through outbound activity, referrals, events, campaigns, and account-based selling.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline with accurate CRM activity, opportunity updates, and forecasting.
  • Lead consultative discovery to uncover customer pain points, business priorities, decision criteria, and value drivers.
  • Present SaaS solutions, proposals, and business cases tailored to dealership leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Coordinate internal resources including sales leadership, product specialists, pre-sales, marketing, and customer success to support complex opportunities.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to close mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Maintain market intelligence on competitors, customer trends, objections, and emerging opportunities.

• Proven hunter mentality with strong prospecting discipline and a bias for action.
  • Demonstrated success selling SaaS, cloud-based, or mission-critical software solutions.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility and communicate value clearly.
  • Consultative seller who focuses on business outcomes, not just product features.
  • Resilient, self-motivated, organized, and comfortable managing multiple opportunities at once.
  • Automotive retail, dealership, OEM, DMS, CRM, desking, or digital retailing experience is an asset.

• 5 - 8+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology sales.
  • Proven track record of new logo acquisition and consistent quota achievement.
  • Experience selling ARR-based solutions from prospecting through close.
  • Strong pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, and sales process discipline.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Ability to travel as required for prospect meetings, events, and territory development.

• Achievement of quarterly and annual new business ARR targets.
  • Consistent creation and progression of qualified pipeline.
  • Accurate forecasting, strong CRM discipline, and effective territory execution.
  • Successful acquisition of new logo customers in priority segments.

• New business ARR achieved from net-new automotive retail accounts against quarterly and annual targets.
  • Qualified pipeline coverage across priority Alberta dealership groups, rooftops, and independent retailers.
  • New logo dealership opportunities created, advanced, and closed for SaaS solutions such as DMS, CRM, desking, digital retailing, service, or related applications.
  • Outbound activity into target automotive accounts, including dealer principal, general manager, controller, fixed ops, sales, and IT stakeholder engagement.
  • Discovery meetings completed with dealership leadership to uncover operational pain points, current systems, integration needs, and value drivers.
  • Proposal-to-close conversion rate for competitive displacement, modernization, or add-on SaaS opportunities.
  • Forecast accuracy, CRM hygiene, and stage progression for dealership opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Win rate against automotive SaaS competitors and incumbent dealership technology providers.
This role offers the opportunity to join a growing SaaS sales organization, build new business across Western Canada, and help automotive retailers modernize how they operate.

lists.content:
• Own and deliver new business ARR targets within the assigned territory.
  • Prospect, qualify, and develop net-new opportunities through outbound activity, referrals, events, campaigns, and account-based selling.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline with accurate CRM activity, opportunity updates, and forecasting.
  • Lead consultative discovery to uncover customer pain points, business priorities, decision criteria, and value drivers.
  • Present SaaS solutions, proposals, and business cases tailored to dealership leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Coordinate internal resources including sales leadership, product specialists, pre-sales, marketing, and customer success to support complex opportunities.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to close mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Maintain market intelligence on competitors, customer trends, objections, and emerging opportunities.

• Proven hunter mentality with strong prospecting discipline and a bias for action.
  • Demonstrated success selling SaaS, cloud-based, or mission-critical software solutions.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility and communicate value clearly.
  • Consultative seller who focuses on business outcomes, not just product features.
  • Resilient, self-motivated, organized, and comfortable managing multiple opportunities at once.
  • Automotive retail, dealership, OEM, DMS, CRM, desking, or digital retailing experience is an asset.

• 5 - 8+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology sales.
  • Proven track record of new logo acquisition and consistent quota achievement.
  • Experience selling ARR-based solutions from prospecting through close.
  • Strong pipeline generation, qualification, forecasting, and sales process discipline.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Ability to travel as required for prospect meetings, events, and territory development.

• Achievement of quarterly and annual new business ARR targets.
  • Consistent creation and progression of qualified pipeline.
  • Accurate forecasting, strong CRM discipline, and effective territory execution.
  • Successful acquisition of new logo customers in priority segments.

• New business ARR achieved from net-new automotive retail accounts against quarterly and annual targets.
  • Qualified pipeline coverage across priority Alberta dealership groups, rooftops, and independent retailers.
  • New logo dealership opportunities created, advanced, and closed for SaaS solutions such as DMS, CRM, desking, digital retailing, service, or related applications.
  • Outbound activity into target automotive accounts, including dealer principal, general manager, controller, fixed ops, sales, and IT stakeholder engagement.
  • Discovery meetings completed with dealership leadership to uncover operational pain points, current systems, integration needs, and value drivers.
  • Proposal-to-close conversion rate for competitive displacement, modernization, or add-on SaaS opportunities.
  • Forecast accuracy, CRM hygiene, and stage progression for dealership opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Win rate against automotive SaaS competitors and incumbent dealership technology providers.
This role offers the opportunity to join a growing SaaS sales organization, build new business across Western Canada, and help automotive retailers modernize how they operate.

lists.content:
• Take end-to-end responsibility for the resolution of key cases, owning customer engagement, communication, case progression and internal liaison across multiple technical service teams and functions with Keyloop.
  • Responding with empathy to customers, dealing with their needs, and acknowledging their operational pressures and deadlines.
  • Be familiar with your customers’ configuration, business model and key stakeholders in line with our Experience First approach.
  • Communicating and collaborating with team members, other departments and management to deliver timely resolution of customer issues.
  • Documenting solutions and producing written guidance on resolution steps and procedures through the creation and maintenance of knowledge articles.
    • Being passionate and pro-active in acquiring and absorbing knowledge of the Keyloop product suite and associated toolset and working closely with management to increase the level of personal skills and competence. Including AI tools.
      •  
      • Reporting issues, recommending process improvements and the identification of support tools that will minimise queries, improve resolution times and improve customer experience

        •  

        • Self-Motivation & initiative to aid your investigation process and career development.
          • Effectively coaching and mentoring colleagues in order to expedite case resolution while supporting the growth and development of knowledge within support.
          • Ensuring root cause analysis is carried out where necessary.
          • Identify training gaps in our knowledge media and recommend areas for improvement.
          • Actively contribute to case reduction initiatives by identifying opportunities within our customer base and through promotion within our teams.

• Understanding and familiarity with accounting terms and concepts
  • Ability to efficiently plan and prioritise workload to meet deadlines.
  • Expertise or knowledge relating to a specified Keyloop product / module.
    • High level of investigation, analytical, problem solving and trouble shooting skills.
      • Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written.
      • Knowledge and understanding of customer expectations.
      • Ability to influence and overcome objections and de-escalate potentially critical customer situations.
      • Ability to interact with multiple levels of Keyloop customers and internal partners.
      • Ability to explain complex problems, issues and accounting concepts in simple terms

• Accounting experience
  • Experience of International and Standard Accounting.
  • Experience in dealing with customers across a variety of channels and with high level of professionalism

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
descriptionBody:
Purpose of the role

Provision of an excellent support service is critical to the achievement of Keyloop’s strategic plans for growth and profitability. Our Tier 2 Support Analyst will primarily be responsible for owning, troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving problems to successful closure, whilst ensuring timely escalation where necessary.

 

They will also assist colleagues and will not only have outstanding verbal and written communication skills but can demonstrate that they are able to communicate quickly and efficiently at all levels across a Global team (customer, peers, and managers) in order to achieve our departmental and company strategy.

 

This role requires someone who is resourceful and well organised, with excellent analytical and problem solving skills, who is able to work effectively as part of a high performing team with a passion and commitment to providing service excellence.

Our Product Support Analyst will also assist colleagues and will not only have outstanding verbal and written communication skills but can demonstrate that they are able to communicate quickly and efficiently at all levels across a Global team (Customer, peers, and Managers) in order to achieve our departmental and company strategy. 

This role requires someone who is resourceful and well organised, with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, who is able to work effectively as part of a high performing team with a passion and commitment to providing service excellence.

• Owning and progressing cases through to resolution by utilising available resources and expanding own knowledge. 

  • Escalating a case in good time. 

  • Responding with empathy to customers, dealing with their needs, and acknowledging their operational pressures and deadlines. 

  • Communicating cooperatively with team members, other departments and management to deliver timely resolution of customer issues. 

  • Documenting solutions and producing written guidance on resolution steps and procedures. 

  • Being passionate and pro-active in acquiring and absorbing knowledge of the Keyloop product suite and associated toolset and working closely with management to increase the level of personal skills and competence. 

  • Self-Motivation & initiative to aid your investigation process and career development. 

  • Effectively coaching and mentoring colleagues in order to expedite case resolution and enhance the level of knowledge within support. 

  • Ensuring root cause analysis is carried out where necessary. 

  • Identify training gaps in our knowledge media and recommend areas for improvement. 

  • Actively contribute to case reduction initiatives.

• Ability to efficiently plan and prioritise workload to meet deadlines. 

  • Investigation, analytical, problem solving and trouble shooting skills. 

  • Excellent communication skills, including telephone, virtual methods, written, and verbal skills in German and English language. 

  • Able to articulate simply complex problems or issues. 

  • Knowledge and understanding of customer expectations. 

  • Ability to influence and overcome objections. 

  • Ability to interact with multiple levels of Keyloop customers and associates.

• Experience of working with customers
